stops.note: lord, master, the root behind a hooded masquerade cloak once worn by clergy
applied to a hooded masquerade costume, and later a black-and-white spotted game tile resembling its mask
stops.meaning: a masquerade costume, later a game tile

stops.note: settled as the English word for the small rectangular game tile
stops.meaning: a small rectangular tile used in games

current_meaning: a small rectangular tile marked with dots, used in games, or a chain reaction
